# Analyzer errors (PHEL000-099)

The analyzer walks the parsed forms and resolves every symbol, arity and binding. A code in this range means the file parsed and does not make sense.

| Code | Error |
|---|---|
| [PHEL001](#phel001-undefined-symbol) | Undefined symbol |
| [PHEL002](#phel002-wrong-number-of-arguments) | Wrong number of arguments |
| [PHEL003](#phel003-wrong-argument-type) | Wrong argument type |
| [PHEL004](#phel004-duplicate-definition) | Duplicate definition |
| [PHEL005](#phel005-error-while-expanding-a-macro) | Error while expanding a macro |
| [PHEL006](#phel006-error-while-expanding-an-inline-function) | Error while expanding an inline function |
| [PHEL007](#phel007-invalid-special-form) | Invalid special form |
| [PHEL008](#phel008-invalid-binding-form) | Invalid binding form |
| [PHEL009](#phel009-invalid-interface-implementation) | Invalid interface implementation |
| [PHEL010](#phel010-invalid-recur) | Invalid recur |
| [PHEL011](#phel011-value-in-call-position-is-not-callable) | Value in call position is not callable |

## PHEL001: Undefined symbol

Enum case: `ErrorCode::UNDEFINED_SYMBOL`

The analyzer reached a symbol that is bound nowhere: not in the current namespace, not in a required namespace, and not in a local binding.

```phel
(undefined-fn 1 2)
```

**Fix:** Check the spelling, require the namespace that defines it, or define it before the call.

## PHEL002: Wrong number of arguments

Enum case: `ErrorCode::ARITY_ERROR`

The analyzer knows the arity of the function being called and the call site does not match it. It fires only for a global definition the compiler has already seen.

```phel
(map)
```

**Fix:** Pass the number of arguments the function declares.

## PHEL003: Wrong argument type

Enum case: `ErrorCode::TYPE_ERROR`

A special form got the wrong kind of value in a fixed position. The analyzer checks these shapes before any code runs.

```phel
(def 1 2)
```

**Fix:** Put the type the form expects in that position, here a symbol.

## PHEL004: Duplicate definition

Enum case: `ErrorCode::DUPLICATE_DEFINITION`

The same name is defined twice in one namespace. The analyzer reports the second definition and names the line of the first. The REPL and `phel eval` stand this guard down, so it only fires on a file.

```phel
(ns app.core)
(def a 1)
(def a 2)
```

**Fix:** Rename one of the two definitions, or delete the one you no longer need.

## PHEL005: Error while expanding a macro

Enum case: `ErrorCode::MACRO_EXPANSION_ERROR`

A macro threw while the analyzer was expanding a call to it. The report gives the failing call, the cause, and where the macro is defined.

```phel
(defmacro boom [] (/ 1 0))
(boom)
```

**Fix:** Fix the macro body, or the arguments the call passes to it.

## PHEL006: Error while expanding an inline function

Enum case: `ErrorCode::INLINE_EXPANSION_ERROR`

The `:inline` function on a definition threw while the analyzer was expanding a call to it. Same failure as a macro expansion, on the inline path.

```phel
(defn ^{:inline (fn [x] (/ 1 0))} f [x] x)
(f 1)
```

**Fix:** Fix the `:inline` function so it returns a form for every call it accepts.

## PHEL007: Invalid special form

Enum case: `ErrorCode::INVALID_SPECIAL_FORM`

The fallback code for an analyzer error that carries no more specific one. Editor diagnostics report it under this code; the terminal prints the same message with no code in front.

```phel
(let [1 2] 3)
```

**Fix:** Read the message: it names the form and the value it rejected.

## PHEL008: Invalid binding form

Enum case: `ErrorCode::BINDING_ERROR`

A `let`, `loop` or destructuring binding has the wrong shape. The binding list must be a vector of an even number of forms, and every bound name must be an unqualified symbol.

```phel
(let (a 1) a)
```

**Fix:** Write the bindings as a vector of name and value pairs.

## PHEL009: Invalid interface implementation

Enum case: `ErrorCode::INTERFACE_ERROR`

A `defstruct` or `defenum` names an interface the analyzer cannot resolve, or leaves one of its methods unimplemented.

```phel
(defstruct point [x y] Unknown)
```

**Fix:** Import the interface, spell the name the way the `ns` form does, and implement every method it declares.

## PHEL010: Invalid recur

Enum case: `ErrorCode::RECUR_ERROR`

`recur` was used outside the tail of a `loop` or `fn`, or with an argument count that does not match the recursion point.

```phel
(recur 1)
```

**Fix:** Move the `recur` into the tail of a `loop` or `fn` and pass one argument per binding.

## PHEL011: Value in call position is not callable

Enum case: `ErrorCode::NOT_CALLABLE`

A literal number, string, boolean or `nil` sits at the head of a list. The analyzer rejects it instead of letting PHP fail at runtime.

```phel
(1 2)
```

**Fix:** Drop the parentheses, or put a function at the head of the list.
